notes:
{石|いし} covers both small stones you can pick up and stone as a material. For large boulders or bedrock, ⟦{岩|いわ}→岩：00850_iwa⟧ is used instead.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {石|いし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投|な}げる→投げる：01135_nageru⟧: to throw a stone
- {石|いし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拾|ひろ}う→拾う：00845_hirou⟧: to pick up stones
- {石|いし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{三年|さんねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧: perseverance pays off (lit. three years on a stone)
- ⟦{一石二鳥|いっせきにちょう}→一石二鳥：04764_issekinichou⟧: killing two birds with one stone

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{宝石|ほうせき}→宝石：03619_houseki⟧: jewel, gem
- ⟦{岩石|がんせき}→岩石：20502_ganseki⟧: rock (scientific/geological)
- ⟦{石橋|いしばし}→石橋：noentry⟧: stone bridge
- ⟦{石垣|いしがき}→石垣：19673_ishigaki⟧: stone wall
- ⟦{化石|かせき}→化石：11796_kaseki⟧: fossil

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {石|いし}: stone or rock (general, any size up to what you might carry)
- ⟦{岩|いわ}→岩：00850_iwa⟧: boulder, large rock, bedrock (too large to move easily)
